name: drop the off-catalog prepend, so a suggestion the catalog lacks vanishes and the band silently offers a different model
return the caller's catalog by reference, so a card build can mutate the Config's list
hand the raw config catalog to the card, bypassing model_options entirely
emit the label as the option value, so `--model "Opus 4.8"` reaches the CLI and the launch fails
old: <option value="{{ m.value }}"{% if m.value == sm or (not sm and loop.first) %} selected{% endif %}>{{ m.label }}</option>
new: <option value="{{ m.label }}"{% if m.value == sm or (not sm and loop.first) %} selected{% endif %}>{{ m.label }}</option>

name: drop `loop.first`, so nothing is selected and the browser's implicit first-option choice becomes invisible
old: <option value="{{ m.value }}"{% if m.value == sm or (not sm and loop.first) %} selected{% endif %}>{{ m.label }}</option>
new: <option value="{{ m.value }}"{% if m.value == sm %} selected{% endif %}>{{ m.label }}</option>

name: emit the value as the option text, so the selector stops naming versions and reads as raw ids
old: <option value="{{ m.value }}"{% if m.value == sm or (not sm and loop.first) %} selected{% endif %}>{{ m.label }}</option>
new: <option value="{{ m.value }}"{% if m.value == sm or (not sm and loop.first) %} selected{% endif %}>{{ m.value }}</option>

name: default the catalog to a pinned version, freezing every ad-hoc launch on a model that ages out
relabel a pinned version so the selector no longer names it the way a human would
drop the alias's version gloss, so "opus" no longer says what it currently means
duplicate a catalog value, so one id renders twice under two different labels
